draft.title: Technical vocabulary and register
card: Each subject and form has its own special words. A science report uses words such as variable and hypothesis. A film review uses words such as mise-en-scène and close-up.
Register is the level of formality in writing. It changes with the audience, the purpose and the form. A report to a principal is formal. A text to a friend is casual.
Precise technical terms say exactly what is meant, so the reader can trust the writer. A vague phrase such as "the bit where the camera goes close" sounds less informed than "a close-up".
The terms and the register must suit each other and the form. Slang in a formal report weakens it. Heavy jargon in a note to a younger student may leave the reader lost.
draft.remember: Use the right terms for the subject, at the level of formality the audience and form need.

a.q: Which sentence from a formal film review uses technical vocabulary and a suitable register?
opts: The director uses a close-up to show the character's fear
The director does a zoomed-in shot so we know she's scared
The director goes hard on showing the character's fear
The director has the camera get up near the character's face
a.why: A close-up is the correct term for this shot, and the sentence stays formal. The zoomed-in option describes the shot in casual, vague words instead of naming it.
a.clue: Look for the exact film term in a formal tone.

b.q: Jaya writes a formal science report. Which sentence would best suit its register and purpose?
opts: The results show the independent variable affected growth
The results show the thing we changed messed with growth
The results show the plants went totally nuts in new soil
The results show changing stuff in soil made plants weird
b.why: Independent variable is a precise science term, and the sentence stays formal, so it suits a report. The option about the thing we changed is casual and vague, so it is less precise and less credible.
b.clue: A formal report needs a precise term, not a casual phrase.

a.best: The director uses a close-up to show the character's fear

b.best: The results show the independent variable affected growth
